description: This Java source file defines the InputManagerV16 class, which provides an implementation of InputManagerCompat for API level 16 (Jelly Bean). It wraps around Android's InputManager to manage input device listeners and input device queries, facilitating input device management with compatibility features.

classes.name: InputManagerV16
classes.description: Implements InputManagerCompat for Jelly Bean, managing input device listeners and device queries.

classes.name: V16InputDeviceListener
classes.description: Adapter class implementing InputManager.InputDeviceListener, forwarding events to a provided InputDeviceListener.

methods.name: InputManagerV16
methods.description: Constructor initializing InputManager and internal listener map.

methods.name: getInputDevice
methods.description: Retrieves InputDevice by ID using the wrapped InputManager.

methods.name: getInputDeviceIds
methods.description: Returns array of input device IDs.

methods.name: registerInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Registers a new input device listener, wrapping it with V16InputDeviceListener.

methods.name: unregisterInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered input device listener.
